In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], a '''robbery''' occurred at the [[Sun King's palace]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] when several [[Icehead]]s stole the [[season scepter]], a [[Magic/Legends|magical]] device used to control the weather on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]].
